root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndNoLoadTests NoLoadTest
Type: object

No-load test results determine core admittance parameters. They include exciting current and core loss measurements from applying voltage to one winding. The excitation may be positive sequence or zero sequence. The test may be repeated at different voltages to measure saturation.

No Additional Properties

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndNoLoadTests NoLoadTest IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndNoLoadTests NoLoadTest IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndShortCircuitTests
Type: array

Array of ShortCircuitTest objects

Each item of this array must be:

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndShortCircuitTests ShortCircuitTest
Type: object

Short-circuit test results determine mesh impedance parameters. They include load losses and leakage impedances. For three-phase windings, the excitation can be a positive sequence (the default) or a zero sequence. There shall be at least one grounded winding.

No Additional Properties

IdentifiedObject.description

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndShortCircuitTests ShortCircuitTest IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndShortCircuitTests ShortCircuitTest IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndShortCircuitTests ShortCircuitTest IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndShortCircuitTests ShortCircuitTest IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

Ravens.cimObjectType

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.CoreAdmittance Ravens.cimObjectType
Type: enum (of string)

Used in RAVENS Schema to identify the corresponding CIM Object Type of the JSON object.

Must be one of:

  • "TransformerCoreAdmittance"

IdentifiedObject.description

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.CoreAdmittance IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.CoreAdmittance IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.CoreAdmittance IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.CoreAdmittance IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

TransformerEndInfo.ToMeshImpedance

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.ToMeshImpedance
Type: array

Array of TransformerMeshImpedance objects

No Additional Items

Each item of this array must be:

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.ToMeshImpedance TransformerMeshImpedance
Type: object

Transformer mesh impedance (Delta-model) between transformer ends.
The typical case is that this class describes the impedance between two transformer ends pair-wise, i.e. the cardinalities at both transformer end associations are 1. However, in cases where two or more transformer ends are modelled the cardinalities are larger than 1.

No Additional Properties

IdentifiedObject.description

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.ToMeshImpedance TransformerMeshImpedance IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.ToMeshImpedance TransformerMeshImpedance IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.ToMeshImpedance TransformerMeshImpedance IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

Transformer star impedance (Pi-model) that accurately reflects impedance for transformers with 2 or 3 windings. For transformers with 4 or more windings, TransformerMeshImpedance class shall be used.
For transmission networks use PowerTransformerEnd impedances (r, r0, x, x0, b, b0, g and g0).

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.TransformerStarImpedance IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.TransformerStarImpedance IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.OpenEndOpenCircuitTest OpenCircuitTest
Type: object

Open-circuit test results verify winding turn ratios and phase shifts. They include induced voltage and phase shift measurements on open-circuit windings, with voltage applied to the energised end. For three-phase windings, the excitation can be a positive sequence (the default) or a zero sequence.

IdentifiedObject.description

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.OpenEndOpenCircuitTest OpenCircuitTest IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.OpenEndOpenCircuitTest OpenCircuitTest IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.OpenEndOpenCircuitTest OpenCircuitTest IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.OpenEndOpenCircuitTest OpenCircuitTest IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

TransformerEndInfo.phaseAngleClock

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.phaseAngleClock
Type: integer

Winding phase angle where 360 degrees are represented with clock hours, so the valid values are {0, ..., 11}. For example, to express the second winding in code 'Dyn11', set attributes as follows: 'endNumber'=2, 'connectionKind' = Yn and 'phaseAngleClock' = 11.

TransformerEndInfo.ratedU

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.ratedU
Type: object or number

Rated voltage: phase-phase for three-phase windings, and either phase-phase or phase-neutral for single-phase windings.

No Additional Properties

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo TransformerEndInfo.endNumber
Type: integer

Number for this transformer end, corresponding to the end's order in the PowerTransformer.vectorGroup attribute. Highest voltage winding should be 1.

IdentifiedObject.name

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

IdentifiedObject.description

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo TransformerTankInfo.TransformerEndInfos TransformerEndInfo IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root PowerTransformerInfo PowerTransformerInfo.TransformerTankInfos TransformerTankInfo IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.
